findings.body: This browser test starts with the test-auth endpoint and covers one successful onboarding submission. It does not exercise the Google callback, repeat sign-in after a Google email change, or two simultaneous onboarding submissions. Those required account identity and exactly-once behaviors have no end-to-end proof through the real sign-in entry point.
findings.title: Not done: apps/web/e2e/onboarding.spec.ts

findings.body: The test posts to test-auth and navigates directly to `/not-open-yet`, so it never proves that Google sign-in redirects an unlisted account there or preserves the return path. It also does not check that a rejected account leaves no stored data, that an existing account survives an email change, or that an inactive pending sign-in is erased after 30 days. The required end-to-end coverage for the listed-email and unfinished-sign-in behavior is incomplete.
